body.statement: A solution of \(\mathrm{oeq:coupled-measurable-attainment}\), combined with \(\widetilde\theta_n\), yields \(\mathcal A^*\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}\) whose empirical selected ambient box at depth \(k+1\) is the lexicographically first eligible closed child of its unique depth-\(k\) selected ambient box under the fixed arm-within-stratum coordinate order, with shared-boundary children tested separately and no unrelated cell eligible. Every fixed empirical prefix stabilizes to \(\mathcal D_k^\dagger\), its feasible cells stabilize to the nested population cells \(\mathcal C_k^\dagger\), and \(\widehat r_n\to r^\dagger\) locally uniformly in probability, where \(\{r^\dagger\}=\bigcap_{k=0}^{\infty}\mathcal C_k^\dagger\). Moreover, \(\sqrt n\{\widetilde\theta_n-\theta_p(q_n(h,v))\}\Rightarrow N(0,\Sigma(r^\dagger))\) uniformly over every fixed bounded nuisance fiber, and \(\mathcal R_+(\mathcal A^*)\le V^*\). Hence the lower and upper deterministic-limit local minimax envelopes both equal \(V^*\).
body.justification: The upper theorem matches the full-nuisance converse with an implementable pilot, joint estimator, and terminal rule.
body.gap: Nwankwo et al. attain scalar ATE variance and Cook et al. prove scalar adaptive AIPW limits; neither couples a set-valued regret design to a multivariate discontinuous minimax rule.
body.consumer: Independent validation of a frozen clinical-policy menu can target scarce follow-up toward the cells that minimize eventual welfare loss.
body.proof_tex:
Use the measurable procedure furnished by \(\mathrm{thm:coupled\text{-}measurable\text{-}attainment}\): fully label the independent pilot, select \(\widehat r_n\in\mathcal R_B\), annotate main-wave records independently at those rates, compute \(\widetilde\theta_n\), and apply its rectangle-constant Gaussian rule to the signal \(\sqrt n\,\widetilde\theta_n\). Pilot vanishing, feasibility, and \(\widehat r_n\to r^\dagger\) show that this sequence is an element \(\mathcal A^*\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}\), with exactly the stated stabilized tree path.

Let \(c_{ax}=p_xe_{ax}\), \(\beta_n=\beta(q_n(h,v))\), and \(b=\beta_n-\widehat\beta\). Conditional on \(\mathscr P_n\), define the cell vector
\[
H_i(c)=\frac{\mathbf1\{X_i=x,A_i=a,R_i=1\}}{c_{ax}\widehat r_{n,ax}}
(Y_i^{\mathrm{obs}}-\widehat\beta_{ax}).
\]
Annotation ignorability gives \(E(H_i\mid\mathscr P_n)=b\), so \(\widetilde\beta_n\) is exactly conditionally unbiased for \(\beta_n\). Since only one cell coordinate can be nonzero,
\[
\operatorname{Var}(H_i\mid\mathscr P_n)
=\operatorname{diag}_{a,x}\left\{
\frac{\sigma^2_{n,ax}+b_{ax}^2}{p_xe_{ax}\widehat r_{n,ax}}
\right\}-bb^\top.
\]
Therefore the exact conditional covariance of the contrast error is
\[
S_n=A_{\mathrm{map}}\left[
\operatorname{diag}_{a,x}\left\{
\frac{\sigma^2_{n,ax}}{p_xe_{ax}\widehat r_{n,ax}}
\right\}
+\operatorname{diag}_{a,x}\left\{
\frac{b_{ax}^2}{p_xe_{ax}\widehat r_{n,ax}}
\right\}-bb^\top\right]A_{\mathrm{map}}^\top.
\]
The last two terms form the covariance of the random vector with coordinates \(b_c\mathbf1\{C=c,R=1\}/(c_c\widehat r_{n,c})\), hence are positive semidefinite. Pilot concentration gives \(\lVert b\rVert=O_P(m_n^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2})\) uniformly on a fixed nuisance fiber, and the affine local chart gives \(\max_c|\sigma^2_{n,c}-\sigma^2_c(q^0)|=O(n^{-1/2})\). Consequently
\[
\lVert S_n-\Sigma(\widehat r_n)\rVert
=O_P(m_n^{-1}+n^{-1/2})=o_P(1),
\qquad S_n\to_P\Sigma(r^\dagger).
\]

The summands are uniformly bounded because \(Y\) is bounded and \(p_x,e_{ax},\widehat r_{n,ax}\) have positive floors. Menu rank and the variance floor give a uniform positive lower covariance eigenvalue. Thus \(\mathrm{lem:bentkus\text{-}convex\text{-}set}\), conditionally on the pilot, proves
\[
\sqrt n\{\widetilde\theta_n-\theta_p(q_n(h,v))\}\Rightarrow
N(0,\Sigma(r^\dagger))
\]
uniformly on every fixed bounded nuisance fiber. The coupled theorem's rectangle count makes the same normal approximation valid for its changing rule, and its covariance and numerical errors vanish. Since \(\sqrt n\theta_p(q_n(h,v))=h\), the conditional risk is at most
\[
L(\widehat r_n)+o_P(1)=V^*+o_P(1),
\]
uniformly on that fiber. Bounded regret converts convergence in probability to convergence of expectations. Taking first \(n\to\infty\) for fixed \(C_v\), and only then \(C_v\to\infty\), gives \(\mathcal R_+(\mathcal A^*)\le V^*\). The converse \(\mathcal R_-(\mathcal A)\ge V^*\) for every admissible procedure was proved in \(\mathrm{thm:local\text{-}minimax\text{-}lower\text{-}bound}\); hence both deterministic-limit envelopes equal \(V^*\).
